name: hangar
description: Nine bays. Point each one at a folder and a Claude agent starts there, live, in the tile.
author: tools-for-agents

extendInfo.NSDesktopFolderUsageDescription: hangar starts a Claude agent in the folder you pick. If that folder is on your Desktop, the agent needs to read and write it.
extendInfo.NSDocumentsFolderUsageDescription: hangar starts a Claude agent in the folder you pick. If that folder is in Documents, the agent needs to read and write it.
extendInfo.NSDownloadsFolderUsageDescription: hangar starts a Claude agent in the folder you pick. If that folder is in Downloads, the agent needs to read and write it.
extendInfo.NSRemovableVolumesUsageDescription: So a bay can be pointed at a project on an external disk.
extendInfo.NSNetworkVolumesUsageDescription: So a bay can be pointed at a project on a network share.
extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: jarvis — hangar's voice — listens for your wake word so you can talk to your agents. Audio never leaves this Mac.
